name: The Fare of Lar'korwi

faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder sends you to find it in Un'Goro Crater.
The kill belongs to Lar'korwi, a fierce beast roaming Un'Goro Crater.
Lar'korwi's freshest prey is a threshadon.
faq.q: What kind of creature was killed?

faq.answer: The search takes place in Un'Goro Crater.

sections.body: In the wilds of Un'Goro Crater, Torwa Pathfinder tracks the beast Lar'korwi. You are sent to search the basin for the predator's freshest kill, take a piece of the threshadon carcass, and return with it to Torwa.
sections.title: A Hunter's Scent

summary: Torwa Pathfinder seeks a piece of a fresh threshadon carcass left behind by the beast Lar'korwi. In the wilds of Un'Goro Crater, you must find the predator's latest kill and return with the meat.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Fare of Lar'korwi
